title: Standard AppBot Window T1 Core
desc: Core definition and caller-HWND rules for Standard AppBot Window. This is the shortest entrypoint for placement and IPC identity.
steps: Use the nearest ancestor process that owns a usable window as the Standard AppBot Window.
Never use foreground as a caller signal; ancestor walk is the only source of truth.
Return Zero when no valid caller window exists and skip placement.
author: claude
